author: dratypol
quote: Game can not maintain a stable 30fps; frame rate dropping into low 20s at times when just driving and not anything intense happening even on the PS5 Pro. Jittering is an immersion break.A major disappointment performance wise and there is no excuse for these issues. There are many boring segments in the game such as doing chores around the house and picking up groceries; people play games to escape the monotony of everyday chores, not to emulate them.
